subject: Private deployment: tenant safeguards, audit window & pricing request
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diane Cho <diane.cho@aventishealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: tenant safeguards, audit window & pricing request

Hi Diane,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Aventis is looking at a private (VPC/on-prem) deployment for the clinical NLP pilot with the following asks summarized so we can align the commercial and legal sides:

- Data residency: entire tenant and backups must remain in US-East region (no cross-region replication).
- KMS: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) with Redwoods supporting key rotation guidance; no Redwood personnel access to keys.
- Audit rights: Aventis requests the ability to run security/compliance audits of the deployment windowly — preference is quarterly, but we understand that scope matters.
- Host access: no host-level root access for Aventis; limited log export and aggregated telemetry only.
- Pricing: Aventis is asking for a multi-year commitment discount (they mentioned 25–35% range).

I've attached the term sheet (aventis_term_sheet_v1.pdf) and our latest SOC2 package (soc2_redwood_q1_2026.pdf) for your review.

If you can confirm the priority constraints (audit cadence vs. host access) we can present a single proposal with the minimal exception set for legal to review. Next steps from our side: loop Deal Desk + Legal to assess risk and pricing; I'll coordinate a quick review with Marcus and Laura.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: aventis_term_sheet_v1.pdf, soc2_redwood_q1_2026.pdf

From: Diane Cho <diane.cho@aventishealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@aventishealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: tenant safeguards, audit window & pricing request

Hi Grace — thanks for the summary. A couple of clarifying points from our security and procurement teams:

- Audit cadence: remote reviews are fine, but Aventis requires the option for an on-site audit once per year and a remote audit window quarterly. We typically require a 30 calendar day audit window (ability to schedule within that window).
- KMS: BYOK is required; we will want an MOU that spells out non-access for Redwood personnel and an escrow arrangement if keys are lost.
- Logs: we want access to session and API-level logs (redacted for PII) for up to 12 months.
- SLA/availability: we will want a 99.9% SLA and a service credit schedule for downtime beyond that.
- Pricing: we can commit to a 3 year term for production if Redwood can provide a 35% discount and a one-time integration engineering credit to cover the on-prem deployment effort.

I've attached our redlines (Aventis_redlines_20261002.pdf). Please route the redlines to legal and deal desk; Contracts will follow up with a formal SOW if we can get commercial alignment.

Regards,
Diane Cho
Head of Information Security | Aventis Health
diane.cho@aventishealth.com
Attachments: Aventis_redlines_20261002.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment: tenant safeguards, audit window & pricing request

Grace — flagged. Quick read of the asks: 35% and quarterly on-site audit is beyond standard authorizations. My suggested position to reduce risk:

- Accept BYOK (customer-managed KMS) but require a documented key-escrow procedure (legal to draft) and no key transfered to Redwood.
- Audit rights: propose remote access quarterly (log/API review) and one on-site per year with 5 business days notice; if Aventis insists on quarterly on-site, require scope limits and Redwood engineer escort and NDA for visiting staff.
- Logs: 12 months retention for aggregated API logs is okay, PII redaction required (security to confirm).
- SLA: 99.9% is standard; negotiate service credits per SOW.
- Pricing: recommend counter to 22% discount with a $40k one-time engineering integration fee to offset infra work and carve-outs.

I've run a quick internal risk note (security_risk_aventis_2026-10-03.docx) — attaching for Laura and Rishi. If legal and deal desk are comfortable, we can escalate to execs for a one-time approved exception.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin | Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: security_risk_aventis_2026-10-03.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Deal desk: request for exec signoff — Aventis (DEAL-2026-3497)

Team,

This is an official Deal Desk escalation. Summary: Aventis Health requests a private deployment (US-East) with BYOK, 12 month log retention, quarterly remote audits + one on-site per year (they asked quarterly on-site), and a 35% discount for a 3-year commit. Proposed commercial / legal compromise: 22% recurring discount, $40k one-time integration fee, BYOK + escrow clause, remote quarterly reviews and one on-site yearly with strict scope & escort, and a signed addendum for audit procedures.

Why execs: discount >20% and the audit carve-outs / escrow are non-standard and require Exec approval to waive standard hosting controls and to accept the tradeoff. I've attached a deal summary and expected margin impact (deal_summary_DEAL-2026-3497.xlsx).

Please advise if VP Sales / CRO or CFO can approve the exceptions as drafted. If we get a provisional ok, Legal will prepare the addendum for signature and I'll generate the updated commercial SOW.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra | Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal_summary_DEAL-2026-3497.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal desk: request for exec signoff — Aventis (DEAL-2026-3497)

Thanks for the clear summary. After reviewing the risk note and commercial impact, I am prepared to approve a one-time exception with these concrete constraints:

1) Commercial: cap the recurring discount at 22% for the signed term; include a $40,000 one-time engineering integration fee in the SOW. No incremental concessions.
2) Audit: accept remote quarterly reviews and a single on-site audit per 12-month period. On-site audits require 5 business days notice and scope limited to system configuration and access logs only; no host-level file system access.
3) KMS / keys: BYOK accepted with documented escrow procedure: keys remain under customer control; escrow only triggered under narrowly defined incident scenarios and requires mutual approval.
4) Logs & data residency: Confirmed — tenant data and backups must remain in US-East. Redwood to provide redacted API/session logs for 12 months.
5) Legal: require an Exceptions Addendum to the MSA with the above points plus an indemnity carve-out for custom engineering work. Laura, please prepare the addendum and route for signatures.

This approval is conditioned on Legal drafting the addendum and Finance confirming the margin impact is acceptable to the quarter. If those two checks pass, Ops and Security are instructed to proceed with a limited enablement plan.

Aditya Rao | Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: approved_exceptions_addendum_DEAL-2026-3497.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diane Cho <diane.cho@aventishealth.com>
Cc: contracts@aventishealth.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private deployment: tenant safeguards, audit window & pricing request

Hi Diane — good news. Execs have provisionally approved a one-time exception set; summary below and next steps.

Approved items (conditions apply):
- Commercial: 22% recurring discount for a 3-year term + $40,000 one-time engineering integration fee.
- Audit: Remote quarterly reviews (logs/API) + one on-site audit per 12 months. On-site requires 5 business days notice and will be limited to config/access logs; an escort and NDA are required.
- KMS: BYOK approved; Legal to include a documented escrow mechanism for defined incident cases only.
- Data residency: Tenant + backups to remain in US-East.
- Logs: Redwood will provide redacted API/session logs for 12 months.

Next steps:
1) Legal (Laura) will publish the Exceptions Addendum and route for signature (I attached the provisional addendum: approved_exceptions_addendum_DEAL-2026-3497.pdf).
2) Rishi will update the SOW with the discount and integration fee and create the DocuSign envelope.
3) Marcus / Security will coordinate a technical enablement checklist (BYOK steps, logging config) once addendum is signed.

Diane, please confirm acceptance of the conditions above and Contracts can expect a DocuSign link within 24 hours. If that works I’ll schedule an internal kickoff for Oct 12 to align on the integration plan.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachments: approved_exceptions_addendum_DEAL-2026-3497.pdf
